rules.summary: Every command exit map is non-empty, has unique numeric codes, and includes success code 0 plus every host-owned exit-code role.
invalidInvocation, cancellation, and internalFailure are distinct positive reservations and never share code 0 or the help exit code.
Every present stdin, stdout, or stderr contract carries one non-null exact schemaRevision.
A source whose maximum occurrence exceeds one binds only as System.Collections.Immutable.ImmutableArray`1<TScalar> with exactly one scalar generic argument from the finite logical type catalog.

The selected shell host operationBindings are authoritative; each command requestSchemaRevisions, resultSchemaRevisions, and diagnosticSchemaRevisions set must exactly match the corresponding operation binding set.
